machineScope.reason: It records the launches this host's resource owner holds open and their measured resource outcomes; both describe only this machine's own processes, and a closed launch's row is removed by an atomic replace.

requiredFacts.criticality: The one funnel every provider launch of this host passes. It refuses a launch past the hard concurrent-launch ceiling, keeps the answer reserve out of reach of non-critical work, lowers each process's own kernel limits (soft and hard) before anything is spawned, and kills a launch observed past its memory or process ceiling. A resource above the level the operator named is spent or it is not; nothing is asked.
requiredFacts.preservesInput: the launch request waits in the owner's queue until a slot frees, or comes back refused with its reason and its ceiling; no work is discarded and nothing is spawned past the ceiling

holds.portion: the shipped admit path caps local launch slots, preserves the answer reserve, refuses at the queue deadline and drains after capacity returns; tested through hold without launching a process
holds.remainder: kernel CPU/handle limits, sampled memory/process ceilings, escaped descendants, every launch composition and live pressure recovery are not certified by this slot test; verified Part Two extract and independent semantic review remain absent

holds.portion: queued maintenance respects the priority gate and answer reserve, resumes after the gate reopens, and stops when its queued stop signal arrives; the fake-clock test ends with no active work or timers
holds.remainder: whole-system restart/respawn/notification convergence and real host pressure behavior are not proven; verified Part Two extract and independent semantic review remain absent
